state.description: Current state of the presentation flow

role.description: Role of this agent in the flow

requestedCredentials.description: The credentials, and attributes of them, that this flow asked for

credentialDefinitionId.description: AnonCreds credential definition the presentation is restricted to

jsonSchemaCredentialId.description: JSON Schema Credential the presentation is restricted to

attributes.description: Attributes asked of this credential. Every attribute of the schema when omitted.

claims.description: The claims revealed by the presentation. Empty until the holder answers.

verified.description: Whether the presentation verified. Set when the presentation is received, false with an `errorMessage` when the flow is `abandoned`.

errorMessage.description: Error message on the exchange. The agent sets it when the exchange stops. The agent also sets it when it declines an exchange and the peer gets no problem report.

updatedAt.description: When the flow was last updated
